# Data Analysis for WCivic

# Data:

Data obtained from government website. The data will be preprocessed to only use contain data from the last 5 years (2025-2021). This data should be sufficient to view recent trends and patterns that occur

```{r load_data}
# road safety data
road_casualty <- read.csv(file='casualty-last-5-years.csv')
road_collisions <- read.csv(file='collision-last-5-years.csv')
road_vehicles <- read.csv(file='vehicle-last-5-years.csv')

# road traffic data
raw_traffic_data <- read.csv(file='dft_traffic_counts_raw_counts.csv')
traffic_day_per_year <- read.csv(file='dft_traffic_counts_aadf.csv')
local_authority_vehicles <- read.csv(file='local_authority_traffic.csv')

# regional stats
region_traffic_road <- read.csv(file='region_traffic_by_road_type.csv')
region_traffic_vehicle <- read.csv(file='region_traffic_by_vehicle_type.csv')
```

# Data cleaning and preprocessing

```{r select_data}
# warwickshire data
warwickshire_collision <- road_collisions[which(road_collisions$local_authority_highway
                                          == 'E10000031'), ]
```

```{r cleaner}
# join the safety data
safety_data <- merge(x=road_casualty, y=road_collisions, by='collision_index')
safety_data <- merge(x=safety_data, y=road_vehicles, by='collision_index')
```
